channel.title: Macetes GTA 6 (English)
channel.description: GTA 6 cheats, easter eggs, secrets and money tips for PS5 and Xbox, checked against gameplay videos before going live.

item.title: How to Customize Your Car in GTA 6 (Tuning Shop, Engine and Paint)
item.description: In GTA 6 you customize cars at a tuning shop like Coastal Auto Care, near Jason's house. You can change the engine, exhaust, body kit, paint and interior. Register the car first.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Have First Person? (The Phone-While-Driving Trick)
item.description: GTA 6 has no first-person camera option. Pull out your phone while driving, though, and the camera jumps inside the car, with working gauges, gear display and fuel needle.

item.title: GTA 6 Meteorite Location: Where to Find and Sell It
item.description: The GTA 6 meteorite crashed into a campsite on the east side of Mount Kalaga, in Lummox County. Grab it with Triangle and sell it on the Lifeinvader marketplace or at a pawn shop.

item.title: Can You Replay Missions in GTA 6?
item.description: No. GTA 6 won't let you replay a mission once it's done. The only way back is to load a manual save from before it, though you can restart a mission while you're still in it.

item.title: GTA 6 Bank Account and ATMs: How to Deposit and Protect Your Cash
item.description: Your GTA 6 bank account unlocks in the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me, and then any ATM takes deposits. Until then, hide your cash under the bedroom floorboards in Key Lento.

item.title: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Walkthrough: The First 7 Missions Step by Step
item.description: A step-by-step guide to GTA 6 Chapter 1, from Prologue to Unwanted Attention: the goal of each mission, the controls the game teaches and how to avoid failing.

item.title: How to Rob Stores in GTA 6 Without Getting Caught: Step by Step and Payouts
item.description: To rob a store in GTA 6 without getting caught, park out of sight, clear out witnesses, hide your face and change outfits after. Early on, a register pays around $1,000.

item.title: How to Save in GTA 6: Manual Saves, 15 Slots and Why Saving Gets Disabled
item.description: In GTA 6 you save from the main menu: pick Game, then Save Game. There are 15 manual save slots. Using a cheat disables saving until you quit the game.

item.title: How to Steal Cars in GTA 6: Hotwiring, Slim Jim, Key Cloner and Trackers
item.description: Stealing cars changed in GTA 6: most cars have alarms, keyless cars can't be hotwired and some have trackers. Here's when you get the slim jim and the key cloner, and how to beat trackers.

item.title: How to Get a 6 Star Wanted Level in GTA 6
item.description: Six stars is the top wanted level in GTA 6. PC Gamer and MrDalekJD both got there with a tank stolen from the military base. Once you're there, there's no escape: the police never stop.

item.title: GTA 6 Bigfoot (Skunk Ape) Mission: How to Start It and Get the Camo Sniper Rifle
item.description: GTA 6's Bigfoot is the start of a hidden side quest. After you black out at the effigy in Grassrivers, find a note, call the number and hunt the Skunk Ape at night. The reward is a unique camo sniper rifle.

item.title: GTA 6 Slim Jim and Snap Gun: What They Do and Which Mission Unlocks Them
item.description: The slim jim opens locked cars without smashing glass and comes from Moses in the Chapter 2 mission Moses. The snap gun opens locked doors quietly and comes from Yasmani in Chapter 3.

item.title: How to Store Weapons in Your Trunk and Recover Them at Ammu-Nation in GTA 6
item.description: GTA 6 limits how many guns you carry. The rest go in your Personal Vehicle's trunk, and the Ammu-Nation weapons locker stores and returns every gun you own. Here are the buttons.

item.title: GTA 6 Unique Weapons: Where to Find Rare Guns Early
item.description: GTA 6 hides unique weapon variants around the map, with their own wraps and attachments. Here's where to get the Hunter's Laird 350, the Black Eagle M306, the Kingfishers W-22, Donnie's revolver and more.

item.title: GTA 6 Giant Crab Mystery: Computer Password, Safe Code and Reward
item.description: The giant crab mystery is in a lab in Mariana County. The computer password is CLEAVES, the safe code is 00072 and the boathouse code is 0212. The reward is a stash bag for Brian and the Crabshack VF5 SMG.

item.title: GTA 6 Hidden Features the Game Doesn't Explain
item.description: GTA 6 lets you flip your car back over by pushing it, sit anywhere, turn on autopilot, keep outfits in the trunk to shake the cops and skip a taxi ride for about $100. Here are the controls.

item.title: How to Lose the Police in GTA 6: Heat, Search Zones and Disguises
item.description: To lose the cops in GTA 6, get out of the search zone and stop matching your description: respray your car at Pay 'n' Spray, change outfits or get a haircut. Watch out for stolen car trackers.

item.title: How to Refuel and Repair Your Car in GTA 6
item.description: Pull up to a gas pump, open the Services prompt and pick Refuel to fill up or Repair to fix the car. The price shows first. Electric cars charge at their own stations.

item.title: GTA 6 Characters and Voice Actors: Who Plays Jason, Lucia and the Cast
item.description: Dylan Rourke plays Jason and Manni L. Perez plays Lucia in GTA 6. Here are the main characters, the actors behind them from Rockstar's official credits, and the famous cameos.

item.title: How Long to Beat GTA 6: Story and 100%
item.description: GTA 6's story takes about 45 to 90 hours to beat, depending on how much you explore. Add every optional mission and it's 80 to 100 hours. Doing everything takes 200-plus.

item.title: GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: Side Missions Found So Far
item.description: The GTA 6 Strangers & Freaks trophy asks for 8 stranger mission strands. There's no official list yet. Here's what players have found on day one: Shirley, Kirk, Kenton and street encounters.

item.title: What Happens When You Get Arrested in GTA 6: What You Lose and Keep
item.description: Getting busted in GTA 6 costs you your pocket cash and any guns you picked up, and your personal car gets impounded if you were in it. Banked money, your home stash and guns you bought are safe.

item.title: GTA 6 Age Rating: What It's Rated and Why
item.description: GTA 6 is rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB and PEGI 18 in Europe, for blood and gore, intense violence, drug use, strong sexual content, nudity and strong language.

item.title: GTA 6 Crashing or Stuck on Loading Screen: How to Fix
item.description: If GTA 6 crashes, freezes or won't load, check PlayStation or Xbox server status and restart the game first. On PS5, restore your licenses; on Xbox, fully power cycle the console.

item.title: GTA 6 Download Size: How Many GB on PS5 and Xbox
item.description: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB of free space, according to Rockstar, and PlayStation says to clear at least 212 GB on PS5. The boxed copy has no disc, only a download code.

item.title: GTA 6 FPS and Performance on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S
item.description: GTA 6 runs at 30fps on every console, with no 60fps or performance mode. PS5 Pro holds it best with the sharpest image, while Xbox Series S often dips below 30.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Have Online or 2 Player?
item.description: No. GTA 6 launched on November 19 as a single-player game, with no online mode, co-op or local 2 player. Rockstar hasn't announced when multiplayer will arrive.

item.title: Can You Play GTA 6 on PC, PS4, Xbox One or Game Pass?
item.description: GTA 6 is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PC or PS4 version, Xbox One can only stream it from the cloud, and it isn't part of Game Pass.

item.title: GTA 6 Collectible Cards: Locations and How Much They Sell For
item.description: GTA 6 collectible cards hide in safes and stashes and sell at pawn shops. The one in the early warehouse fetches $6,000 in Hamlet. Here are the confirmed locations and whether you should sell.

item.title: GTA 6 Hair Growth and Weight System Explained
item.description: Hair and beards don't grow on their own in GTA 6. Weight does shift with food and exercise, but only a little. Here's how to change your look, how to gain weight and what the fitness app tracks.

item.title: GTA 6 Mask, Clothing, Tattoo and Barber Shop Locations
item.description: GTA 6 clothing stores, tattoo parlors and salons are listed under the Style tab of the map index, and they never close. For a mask, the confirmed option is a bandana from Ammu-Nation.

item.title: Is Paul Walker's Car in GTA 6? Where to Find the Fast & Furious Eclipse
item.description: Yes: GTA 6 has a nod to Paul Walker's green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious, in a garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands. Wait until you unlock Moses so you can register and keep it.

item.title: GTA 6 UFO Location: How to See the Abduction (The Truth Is Out There Trophy)
item.description: The GTA 6 UFO shows up after 2 a.m. in the woods east of Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. If a car with blinking hazard lights is parked there, the abduction plays out and you get the trophy.

item.title: GTA 6 Fishing and Hunting: How to Do It and Where to Sell
item.description: In GTA 6, fishing starts on the dock behind Jason's house and boosts your focus. Hunting is the one that pays: Bret in Lummox County buys animals straight out of your trunk. Here's how both work.

item.title: GTA 6 Impound: How to Get Your Car Back
item.description: In GTA 6 you get a car out of impound by paying the Scooter Bros app or by going to the lot yourself. The map index shows where it is. Here's what can happen to the stuff in your trunk.

item.title: GTA 6 Kill or Spare Arnold: What Happens
item.description: In the Chapter 1 mission Hey Arnold!, sparing Arnold keeps your criminal profile cleaner, while killing him pushes it toward violent. The next cutscene barely changes. Here's how each choice works.

item.title: How to Sell Cars in GTA 6 (Moses, Randy and Car Registration)
item.description: Sell stolen cars at a Pay 'n' Spray (3 a day), to Moses or to Randy. Here's what they pay, how to register a car you want to keep, and how to get one out of the impound.

item.title: Mandy in GTA 6: Where Is Mandy's House and How to Collect Her Rent
item.description: Mandy's house is a short drive from Jason's place: look for the green car in the driveway and the American flag. Here's how to find it in the index and finish Pipework.

item.title: Best GTA 6 Settings to Change Before You Play
item.description: Set movement speed to Jog, keep aiming on Partial, turn on progress notifications and turn off motion blur. Plus helmet, camera zoom, metric units and phone settings in GTA 6.

item.title: How to Increase Focus in GTA 6: Every Method
item.description: Fishing is the fastest way to raise focus in GTA 6, at about 5% per fish. Basketball, the snake, petting animals, food, pool, golf, the shooting range and Shirley's rum run help too.

item.title: How to Fix the Railing in GTA 6 (and Every Other Repair at Jason's House)
item.description: Jason's house has 5 repairs: the back railing, the outside steps, the leaky roof, the bedroom wall and the paint job. Here's where each one is, the buttons, and how it helps with Lucia.

item.title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Every Secret Found So Far
item.description: Every GTA 6 easter egg found so far: Bigfoot (the Skunk Ape), the radio tower egg, the jet ski dog, the alien lab, Michael's boat, Dexter's apartment, the giant crab and more.

item.title: GTA 6 Index: How to Find Missions, Shops and Set a Destination
item.description: In GTA 6, the map index opens with Right on the D-pad and splits into 9 tabs, from Story to Food. Here's what each tab lists, how to set a destination and how Quick Navigation works.

item.title: GTA 6 Sunken Treasure: How to Dive Kenton's Shipwrecks and Make Money
item.description: In GTA 6, dive captain Kenton opens up the shipwrecks with the mission Island Dreams. Dive with the metal detector, collect the treasure and sell it back to him: one dive can pay up to $4,000.

item.title: GTA 6 UFO House Easter Egg: Where the San Andreas House Is and How to Get In
item.description: The UFO house Rockstar teased in the San Andreas remaster is in GTA 6, in Bellville, Leonard County. The front door is fake, but you can break in through the garage.

item.title: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Early and Late Game Methods
item.description: The fastest ways to make money in GTA 6: Kenton's shipwreck dives (up to $4,000), Dog Island, Donnie's packages, robbing other criminals, selling stolen cars and the Ambrosia demolition derby.

item.title: GTA 6 Early Money Warehouse: Where It Is and What to Loot
item.description: South of Vice-Dale County, close to Jason's house, an abandoned warehouse holds a cash bag, a rifle, an SMG, contraband and a safe with a collectible card. You can go right after the prologue.

item.title: All GTA 6 Fence Locations: Where to Sell Stolen Goods
item.description: GTA 6 has 5 fences for drugs, jewelry and marked bills, plus 2 car buyers. Each fence pays best for a different item, and some only pay after you leave.

item.title: GTA 6 Military Base Location: How to Get Into Mile Zero Air Station
item.description: The GTA 6 military base is Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key, in the southwest corner of the map. The easiest way in is the stunt jump ramp on the southeast side. Inside: jets, tanks and helicopters.

item.title: GTA 6 Parrot Money: How to Rob the "Strange Noises" Liquor Store
item.description: The Three Sheets liquor store hides over $2,000 behind its "Strange Noises" robbery: a safe, the register and a stash only the parrot gives away. Talk to it and open the grate behind the generator.
